text:
tess: Quick sync — planning to flip the batching+KV-cache flag in prod for a canary, want alignment on scope and rollback guardrails.

mira: scope? which models/regions?

tess: start with 5% traffic, us-east-1 only, models: redwood-compat-3b + open-llama-7b. keep other regions/large models out for now.

sanjay: perf targets to watch? p50/p95 and errors?

tess: yes — p50 should not regress >10ms, p95 not > +50ms, error-rate increase tolerated <=0.2% absolute. memory/ooms unacceptable.

oliver: SRE asks for automated fallback. if p95 > 600ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows OR error-rate > 0.5% for 5m, flip flag off. Also set circuit-breaker: max inflight per shard = 250.

mira: can we limit canary by customer tier? prefer only non-SLA accounts.

tess: good call — canary audience: 5% of requests from free/dev orgs only, plus synthetic canary traffic from qa-lab.

qa-lab: we'll run our smoke suite and a 10k req throughput soak over those models in staging tonight, then replay subset in prod canary once toggled.

sanjay: requests for metrics collection: token/sec, batch size distribution, cache hit rate (prefix and KV), p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, OOM events. Need dashboards and alert rules.

oliver: I created a short dashboard tile and an alert rule draft. eng-sre-bot will post alerts to #incidents if thresholds breach.

eng-sre-bot: ALERT RULES CREATED: p95_latency_prod_batching_v2 > 600ms (5m) -> channel #incidents; 5xx_rate > 0.5% (5m).

mira: rollout plan? ramp schedule?

tess: plan: 1) toggle flag on for 5% free/dev in us-east-1. 2) wait 10m, sanity checks by SRE/QA. 3) if green, ramp to 20% after 30m. 4) hold 1h at 20% then decide next steps. Manual pause at each step.

oliver: please add a 'kill-switch' runbook entry and make sure ops can flip flag without deploy.

tess: done — runbook link pasted in thread: https://intranet/runbooks/batching-canary (adhoc link). Runbook includes commands and rollback steps.

mira: show me the CLI toggle command?

tess: CLI for ops:

```
# enable canary
redwoodctl flags set use_batching_v2=true --scope=prod --region=us-east-1 --audience=free-dev --percent=5
# rollback
redwoodctl flags set use_batching_v2=false --scope=prod --region=us-east-1
```

oliver: confirm RBAC — only ops/eng-sre and tess/mira can run this.

eng-sre-bot: PERMISSIONS CHECK: toggle allowed for groups: ops, eng-sre, platform-leads.

deploy-bot: STARTING ROLLOUT: feature=use_batching_v2, scope=prod, region=us-east-1, audience=free-dev, pct=5. initiating at 2025-05-02T14:12:30Z.

qa-lab: kicking synthetic traffic now against canary slice and posting results in 10m.

sanjay: will capture perf traces and KV-cache hit distribution and upload to /tmp/canary-1752712345.

mira: reminder — do not touch quantization profiles during canary. keep identical model weights/config.

tess: agreed. also tagging rollback owners: oliver (oncall) + tess (platform lead). If automatic fallback triggers, oliver please confirm and run postmortem.

oliver: I'll watch dashboards. ping me @oliver if anything looks off.

mira: quick code-review ping: PR #4821 adds the feature flag wiring. @sanjay can you give a last look?

sanjay: will review in next 20m.

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT UPDATE: canary reached 5% in 90s, no immediate errors.

tess: thanks everyone. post-rollout: collect 2h of metrics then we reconvene in #eng-platform for go/no-go to 20%. If anything unexpected, flip to false and annotate in runbook. :thumbsup:

mira: thx — standing by.

oliver: note for after-action: add a metric for "batching-induced tail latency" (latency conditioned on batch size > 1).

qa-lab: smoke pass green, no regressions in functional tests.

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE: canary stable at 5% for 30m. no alerts triggered.

sanjay: uploading traces and cache-hit heatmaps now. link: /artifacts/canary/1752712345/results.html

tess: excellent. I'll schedule the 20% ramp in 35m unless objections.

mira: no objections from product.

oliver: proceeding to monitor.

end of thread
